title: Bound exhaustive tuning with exact-shape cross-architecture configuration transfer

source.title: vLLM PR #55956 RTX 5090 BF16 fused-MoE configuration
source.claim_scope: On RTX 5090 for one Qwen3 TP4 BF16 fused-MoE shape, a bounded exact-shape transfer screen produced 18/18 faster token buckets, 1.1690x geometric-mean median speedup and exact output agreement; it is neither exhaustive nor whole-model evidence.

problem_signatures: same operator shape available on other GPU architectures

implementation_recipe: Freeze the exact operator signature from the intended model path, including dtype, logical dimensions, parallel sharding and runtime bucket axis.
Inventory source configurations that match the exact logical shape; treat architecture names only as candidate provenance, never as proof of transferability.
Compile-preflight every distinct source configuration on the target GPU and discard illegal shared-memory, warp or compiler combinations before timing.
Screen the surviving configurations against the current fallback under a fixed wall-clock and candidate budget with randomized interleaving.
Build a target-device table from per-bucket winners only after correctness and repeatability pass, then exercise the production loader entry point.
validation_recipe: Use identical inputs, routing state and seeds for baseline and candidate output comparisons across every retained bucket.
Report every bucket, all paired repeats, an aggregate statistic and the worst paired observation; do not publish only favorable cells.
Verify that the normal configuration lookup resolves the target-device file without an experimental override.
Measure whole-model latency or serving throughput separately and bound expected gain by the operator's measured runtime share.
expected_bottleneck_shifts: The target operator moves from generic tiling toward architecture-appropriate occupancy and memory traffic, after which launch overhead, expert imbalance or adjacent stages can dominate.
Autotuning cost moves from an exhaustive Cartesian product to inventory, compilation preflight and a bounded target screen.
failure_modes: A source configuration exceeds target shared-memory or compiler limits even when the logical operator shape matches.
A superficially similar model uses different per-rank dimensions, top-k, dtype or quantization and invalidates the transfer set.
Selecting a winner from one noisy timing pass overfits measurement order or thermal state.
Kernel speedup is presented as whole-model or theoretical-optimum evidence without runtime-share and serving validation.
A device-name-specific table silently fails to load because its lookup key does not match the runtime-reported device name.
scope_limits: This method reduces search cost; it does not prove the transferred set contains the global optimum.
A target result is valid only for the frozen device, software stack, dtype, logical shape and dispatch buckets unless independently reproduced.
An open community PR is a discovery prior and implementation example, not accepted upstream truth.

algorithmic_decomposition.baseline_dependency: A generic kernel fallback is used because the target hardware-shape key has no tuned entry, while other hardware tables contain the same logical operator shape.
algorithmic_decomposition.partition_axis: independent runtime shape or token-count buckets
algorithmic_decomposition.combine_rule: For each frozen bucket, retain the fastest candidate that passes target compilation, correctness and repeatability gates.
algorithmic_decomposition.finalization: Serialize the per-bucket winners under the exact target-device key and verify the production loader selects them.
algorithmic_decomposition.work_complexity: O(B * C * R) timed trials for B buckets, C bounded transferred candidates and R repeats, instead of O(B * P) exhaustive parameter combinations where C is much smaller than P.
algorithmic_decomposition.span_complexity: Buckets and candidate preflights may be evaluated independently, but paired baseline ordering remains randomized within each measurement block.
algorithmic_decomposition.communication_cost: No runtime communication is added; the search reads configuration metadata and writes one target dispatch table.
anti_patterns: copying one architecture's full table without target timing
changing workload buckets after seeing results
calling a bounded winner theoretically optimal
claiming end-to-end gains from kernel-only evidence

candidate_archetypes.name: exact-shape target-screened device table
candidate_archetypes.template: Collect exact-shape source configs, preflight them on the target, run a bounded randomized per-bucket screen against the fallback, preserve only correct repeatable winners, and publish through the normal device-keyed loader.
